title: Backup Non-Emergency Transportation for a Post-Surgical Medicare Patient
brief: Patient Marguerite Delacroix, a woman in her 60s in Texas recovering from recent foot surgery, has Medicare and is currently relying on family (her niece) for rides to her medical appointments. In her words: 'I can't drive right now and I hate leaning on my niece for every appointment — I'd like a dependable backup for getting where I need to go while I recover.'

title: Bladder-Surgery Recovery Planning & Medication Access Check

contacts: Silver Sage Aging & Community Services Line

title: Confirm Original-Medicare Coverage Before Any DME/Transport Work

title: Dialysis Transportation & Dual-Eligibility Navigation

contacts: State Health & Family Services Medicaid Line

title: Dual-Eligible DME Mobility Groundwork
brief: Marcus, a man in his 50s in California who is dual-eligible (federal Medicare plus state Medicaid), was assigned a healthcare advocate after an intake call. In his own words: 'My back is a mess — scoliosis and everything — I can only walk about 15 to 20 yards before I start losing my balance.

title: Dual-Eligible Dementia Patient: Caregiver Intake, Authorization, and Care Coordination
brief: You are handling a care coordination intake for the documented health-care agent of a 90+ year-old dual-eligible patient with dementia and hypertension. The case record contains a verified health-care power of attorney naming the grandson as the patient's legal personal representative for this coordination.

title: Electric Scooter DME Authorization for a Medicare Patient
brief: You are assisting a male patient in a small Texas city who is seeking an electric scooter for outdoor mobility because hip arthritis, a bulging disc, and neuropathy limit his walking. His insurance is on file, but the benefit has not yet been verified, and he reports an established primary care clinician.

title: Enrolling a Rehab-Discharged Medicare Advantage Member with an In-Network PCP

Westvale County Department of Social Services

title: Food-Insecurity Resource Navigation for a Mobility-Limited Under-60 Patient

In his words: "By the end of the month I run short on food, and I can't get around well enough to go pick things up — is there help I qualify for?" His identity is on file.

title: Four-Wheel Scooter DME Prescription Pathway for a Dual-Eligible Patient

title: Grab Bar Installation Follow-Up — Fall Prevention Home Safety

contacts: Westvale County Community Aging Services (Area Agency on Aging)

title: Ibuprofen Medication-Safety Clarification for a Dual-Eligible Patient

She self-reports diabetes, hypertension, diabetic nerve pain, anxiety, and heart failure, and her intake medication list includes Ibuprofen 800 mg three times daily.

title: Medicare Advantage NEMT activation and meal-delivery recovery

contacts: Lone Star Advantage Complete (MA plan) — Member Services

title: Medicare Scooter — Finding an Assignment-Accepting DME Supplier

On the Day 4 care-plan call she said her main need is "a lightweight, portable electric scooter I can load into the car with my husband's help," and she gave her insurance information and her primary care physician's contact.
contacts: Original Medicare Member Services (Part B benefits line)

title: Medication Access — Pending Pharmacy Pickup for a Dual-Eligible Patient

Intake reported that maintenance medications had been left at her pharmacy, but it did not establish their current pickup status or the actual reason access broke down.

His family caregiver is the primary contact and says: "I need help getting his medicines straightened out — he's on Trazodone 50 and Amlodipine 10, and there are two newer ones, one for allergies and one for constipation, but I don't have those names in front of me."

At her care-coordination intake she said her main need was 'I just want an electric scooter so I can get around' (mobility equipment — being handled separately).

title: Mobility DME plan: confirm care team, coverage, supplier, and the evaluation pathway

title: NEMT enrollment for a home-bound dual-eligible patient

title: Ohio Medicaid Mobility Scooter Request

title: Perioperative Care Coordination for a Dual-Eligible Hip Surgery Patient

title: Pharmacy access and home delivery for a dual-eligible elder with dementia

The family has been struggling to obtain his medications from the pharmacy, but intake did not establish whether the real barrier is cost, coverage, prescription status, delivery, or physical access.

After losing roughly 193 pounds, he has painful redundant skin that is limiting his mobility, and he needs to move forward with the surgical consultation.
contacts: Rock River Family Medicine (referring PCP office)

title: Post-Discharge Records & Medication Continuity Coordination

title: Post-Surgical Nutrition Support for a Fixed-Income Medicaid Patient
